THE OFFICE OF THE UNDER SECRETARY OF DEFENSE HAS APPROVED THE AFSM FOR OPERATION JUMP START FOR THOSE SERVICE MEMBERS WHO DEPLOYED TO THE STATES OF TEXAS, NEW MEXICO, ARIZONA, AND CALIFORNIA FROM 15 MAY 2006 THROUGH 15 JUL 2008. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR THE AFSM ARE OUTLINED IN REFERENCES B AND C. SERVICE MEMBERS MUST MEET THE AOE ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA.

HUMANITARIAN SERVICE MEDAL (HSM). THE DIRECTOR, JOINT STAFF, HAS APPROVED THE HSM FOR THE INDONESIAN EARTHQUAKE RELIEF OPERATION FOR THE PERIOD OF 27 MAY 06 THROUGH 14 JUN 06. NOTE: ONLY THOSE MARINES WHO DIRECTLY PARTICIPATED IN THE IMMEDIATE INDONESIAN EARTHQUAKE RELIEF HUMANITARIAN OPERATION FOR THE PERIOD OF 27 MAY 06 THROUGH 14 JUN 06 MAY BE ELIGIBLE. AS STATED IN REF (B), DIRECT PARTICIPATION IS DEFINED AS BEING PHYSICALLY PRESENT AT THE DESIGNATED LOCATION AND HAVING DIRECTLY CONTRIBUTED TO AND INFLUENCED THE ACTION. DEPLOYMENT TO THE AREA OF HUMANITARIAN ASSISTANCE IN AND OF ITSELF DOES NOT CONSTITUTE HSM ENTITLEMENT. OPERATIONAL COMMANDERS IN THE GRADE OF 0-6 AND ABOVE HAVE BEEN GIVEN DELEGATION OF AUTHORITY FOR DETERMINING HSM ELIGIBILITY AND COMMANDERS SHALL CONSOLIDATE A ROSTER OF ALL MILITARY PERSONNEL WHO MEET THE ABOVE CRITERIA. THIS ROSTER SHOULD BE SUBMITTED TO THE CMC (MMMA) USING AN EXCEL SPREADSHEET (HSM.XLS) VIA THE IMPROVED AWARDS PROCESSING SYSTEM AND INCLUDE FULL NAME, RANK, AND SSN. UPON RECEIPT OF CONSOLIDATED ROSTERS OF ELIGIBLE PERSONNEL, MMMA WILL REPORT THE HSM ON UNIT DIARY AND UPDATE THE 'CAR-HSM' DATABASE POSTED ON THE MMMA WEBSITE.

provision.label: A.
provision.text: NAVAL PERSONNEL ARE AUTHORIZED TO WEAR ONLY ONE NATO MEDAL (THE FIRST ONE AWARDED). SUBSEQUENT NATO MEDALS ARE REPRESENTED BY A BRONZE SERVICE STAR. THE NATO MEDAL PRESENTATION MAY INCLUDE A RIBBON CLASP DENOTING THE SPECIFIC OPERATION FOR WHICH THE AWARD WAS APPROVED. NAVAL PERSONNEL MAY ACCEPT AND RETAIN THE RIBBON CLASP, IF PRESENTED; HOWEVER, IT IS NOT AUTHORIZED TO BE WORN ON THE NATO MEDAL OR SERVICE RIBBON. NAVAL PERSONNEL MAY WEAR ONLY THE BASIC MEDAL OR SERVICE RIBBON. THE PRECEDENCE OF THE NATO MEDAL IS AFTER THE UNITED NATIONS MEDAL AND BEFORE THE MULTINATIONAL FORCE AND OBSERVERS MEDAL.

correction.change: normalize_identifiers.py - period replaced with underscore in every USLM path segment
the period is reserved in USLM for the manifestation suffix, so a segment such as mco/1050.3j is ambiguous against the published grammar
underscore is drawn from the RFC 3986 unreserved set, which the USLM 2.1 Review Guide already requires for version strings
